searchText: Hey everyone, I'm new here! I was wondering how do I get funding for developing on the Eth chain? Or who can I reach out to talk about it? Thanks! <@750115633890328586> this Discord is for Ethereum R&D. If you want to be a core developer you can follow along the current cohort at <#843176491386667018>. If you want to build on the app layer try asking in the Crypto Devs Discord (invite in <#745072678079168654>)
